subject.value: Week 2 Lesson 2B 'How Two Voices Move': two independent voice paths travelling together, shown as four distinct teaching zones of motion

visual_structure.value: Each zone shows the SAME pair of independent luminous strands, one deeper plum-umber strand and one paler pearl-ivory strand, travelling left to right through its own soft-edged luminous field. Zone 1 (oblique): one strand lies calm and level while the other lifts or falls away alone. Zone 2 (contrary): the two strands diverge, one rising while the other descends, opening like a gentle crossing-free fan. Zone 3 (similar): both strands travel the same direction, both rising, but the second travels visibly farther than the first so their gap changes. Zone 4 (strict parallel): both strands travel the same direction by exactly equal amounts, remaining evenly spaced like twin rails; this zone is set apart by a wider breathing gap and a distinctly cooler, quieter, more geometric ornament grammar so it reads as a separate teaching convention, not one of the first three. Arrange zones 1-3 as a flowing arc of related fields and zone 4 as a gently detached fourth field. Delicate filigree and concentric ripples share one ornament grammar across zones; every zone clearly shows two independent paths.

accent_identity.value: strands use ONLY neutral warm plum-umber and pearl-ivory with soft gold-white glow; absolutely NO amber #AB812D vs violet #8964A4 pairing, no interval colours, no rainbow coding. A strand is a voice; hue never encodes an interval or a voice identity.

negative_space.value: reserve calm, lighter, uncluttered quiet zones beneath each of the four fields and across the top for later exact native labels; keep the fields from touching each other's quiet zones

background.value: isolated on a pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), organic soft silhouette edges, nothing touching the frame edges, warm ivory and plum atmosphere inside the fields
